body_markdown:
#### Catania, Sicily (CTA)


##### One-way starting at 30,000 points


Set against the towering backdrop of Mount Etna, a UNESCO World Heritage site, Catania is a standout coastal destination on the island of Sicily. The historic Italian city has served as a filming location for productions including “The Godfather Trilogy” and is known for its striking Baroque architecture crafted from black lava stone and white limestone. Travelers can wander lively fish markets, cobblestone streets and ancient piazzas, savor the flavors and culture of Sicily and take in the dramatic scenery of one of Europe’s most famous volcanic landscapes.
